name: VRM_EXTRACT_LINES
description: VRM_EXTRACT_LINES contains source document lines that have been extracted into the VRM application.

columns.name: EXTRACT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of an extracted line.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a source document.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Internal unique identifier of a source document line.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_SUB_LINE_ID
columns.description: Source document subline unique identifier.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date of source document.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Date when the document is created in the source application.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Date when the document was last updated in the source application.

columns.name: VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Specifies the version of the source product line.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the source document.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: WORKER_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of parallel processes for a concurrent process.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Extraction status of a source document.

columns.name: LEVEL_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that indicates if the extracted line is at the header or line level.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the application to which the transaction entity belongs. Foreign key to the FND applications table.

columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
